# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Don't report security problems in a public issue. Report them privately in this repository's **Security** tab →
[**Report a vulnerability**](https://github.com/Liferay-Community-APAC/liferay-forums/security/advisories/new).
Only the maintainers see the report.

Include the Liferay Forums and Liferay DXP versions, what an attacker can do, and the steps to reproduce it.

We aim to acknowledge a report within five working days, and to keep you informed until it's fixed. Liferay Forums
is a community project, so this is on a best-effort basis. Please give us a reasonable time to release a fix before
you disclose the problem publicly.

A vulnerability in Liferay DXP itself, rather than in Liferay Forums, goes to
[Liferay's security team](https://liferay.dev/portal/security/reporting).

## Supported Versions

Security fixes go into the latest release line.

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 1.0.x | Yes |
